source: Zhang et al. (2024), results of RQ1.xlsx
snippet: whole __init__ method of DQN, lines 8 to 21 of the original
external_dependencies: torch: local stub inside the unit (same criterion as LPL-01 and LPL-05). Checked in the PyTorch source (github.com/pytorch/pytorch): Linear creates weight with shape (out_features, in_features) and bias with (out_features,) (torch/nn/modules/linear.py); Sequential registers the positional layers with the keys '0', '1', '2' (torch/nn/modules/container.py). A negative size raises RuntimeError ('Trying to create tensor with negative dimension'), according to discuss.pytorch.org/t/109007.
comments_in_snippet: Kept, by rule 1: short comments by the author ('define the neural network', 'define the optimizer' etc.). They do not mention the study or the origin of the code.
removed_from_original: lines 1 to 3, imports of torch, numpy and random: torch replaced by the stub; numpy and random not used by the snippet.
line 6, header comment of the class: outside the snippet.
lines 23 to 81, the other methods of DQN (state_dict, forward, load_state_dict, update, get_action): outside the snippet; they depend on real tensors.
lines 84 to 138, classes ReplayMemory and DQNAgent: outside the snippet.
scaffolding: Pure-Python stub of torch, with only what the snippet touches: nn.Sequential, nn.Linear, nn.ReLU, nn.MSELoss and optim.Adam, with the same parameters and default values as the real version (Linear: bias=True; ReLU: inplace=False; Adam: lr=0.001; MSELoss: reduction='mean').

Linear creates weights and bias with the shapes of the real version and raises RuntimeError for a negative size; Sequential keeps the layers in order and returns their parameters in parameters(); Adam keeps the parameters received and refuses an empty list, like the real version.

run(dimensions): receives a dictionary with input_size, n_actions, hidden_size and gamma, builds the network and returns a summary: layers in order, optimizer (shapes of the parameters, rate and whether they are the parameters of the network itself), loss, gamma and n_actions.
Parameters with a default value in the stubs do not count in PAR; Pysmell only flags the __init__ of the snippet (PAR=5).
pinned_behavior: typical: 4 inputs, 2 actions, hidden layer 16, gamma 0.99; Linear(4, 16), ReLU, Linear(16, 2), Adam over the 4 parameters of the network with rate 0.001, MSELoss mean.
invalid: a negative hidden layer raises RuntimeError (it comes from Linear).
not_pinned_on_purpose: Message of the RuntimeError: it comes from the stub; the test only pins the type.
notes: model, optimizer, loss_fn, gamma and n_actions are pinned by name because they are public attributes that the other methods of the original class use (forward, state_dict, update, get_action).
